description: Edit a block by id: title/url for links (and giving: gift options on Planning Center and Pushpay giving links), text for headers, url for embeds, title, artist, releaseAt, cover art (imageUrl) and streaming links for music buttons, urls, rowTitle and postsLayout for rows of posts, rowTitle, feedCount and hideShorts for feeds, faqs and rowTitle for FAQs, images, addImageUrls and rowTitle for galleries, title, appStore and googlePlay for app buttons, title (the name), phone, dialCode, email, company, jobTitle, website, address, times (weekly service times or opening hours; the full set) and imageUrl (a JPEG photo) for contact cards, shopProducts, rowTitle and postsLayout (grid or carousel) for shop products. visible=false hides it without deleting. startsAt/endsAt schedule it (null clears); spotlight=true shows it first, highlighted. Links can carry an image (imageUrl), shown beside the title, or as a big card with the image on top (layout "card"). Links and music buttons can have a looping animation to draw the eye (animation "pulse", "wobble", "glow" or "bounce"; null removes it).

addImageUrls.description: Galleries only: https image links to download and add at the end.

address.description: Contact cards only: a city or address ("" removes it).

animation.description: Links and music buttons: a short looping animation that draws the eye. null removes it. Visitors who turn off motion don't see it.

anyOf.description: A web address (https://…), a bare domain, or an email address.

appStore.description: App buttons only: the App Store link (null removes it; one store link has to stay).

artist.description: Music buttons only: the artist's name.

code.description: Links only: lock the link with a code visitors must type to open it (its address stays hidden until then). A new code replaces the old one; null removes the lock. Codes can't be read back.

dialCode.description: Contact cards only: country code for a phone number typed without one, like "+44".

email.description: Contact cards only: the email address (null removes it).

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

faqs.description: FAQs only: every question and answer, in order, replacing the current list.

feedCount.description: Feeds only: how many show (YouTube 1 or 3, feeds 3 or 5).

giving.description: Gift options, only for giving links on Planning Center (a churchcenter.com /giving link) and Pushpay (pushpay.com/g/…). They're written into the link, so the giving page opens with them filled in. Options left out stay as they are.

amount.description: A suggested amount, like 25 or 25.50. null removes it.

fund.description: Planning Center: the fund's name from its Church Center link (new-building in /giving/to/new-building). Pushpay: the fund's name or key. "" removes it.

recurring.description: Open the giving page set to a recurring gift (Pushpay: monthly). false removes it.

anyOf.description: A web address (https://…), a bare domain, or an email address.

googlePlay.description: App buttons only: the Google Play link (null removes it; one store link has to stay).

hideShorts.description: YouTube channel feeds only: true leaves out Shorts.

imageUrl.description: Links: an https link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (up to 2 MB), such as a logo or cover, to show on the link ("" removes it). Music buttons: new cover art.

images.description: Galleries only: the image ids (from get_my_page) to keep, in order, with alt text. Leave one out to delete it.

layout.description: Links with an image: "button" shows the image small beside the title; "card" shows it large on top, with the title under it.

links.description: Music buttons only: every streaming link to show (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Amazon Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, Bandcamp…), replacing the current list. Before the release date these show as pre-save links.

phone.description: Contact cards only: the phone number (null removes it).

postsLayout.description: Rows of posts only: carousel, grid (3 columns of thumbnails) or single (the first post, big).

releaseAt.description: Music buttons only: the release date. Before it the button counts down and takes reminder emails; null makes it a normal music button, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

rowTitle.description: Rows of posts only: the title above the row ("" removes it).

rules.description: Links only: send some visitors to a different address by country, device or first language; the first matching rule wins. The full list; [] removes them.

is.description: Country codes ("gb", "ie"), devices ("ios", "android", "desktop") or language codes ("es", "fr").

title.description: A different title for these visitors.

shopProducts.description: Shop products only: product links or handles to show, in order, replacing the current ones; [] shows the newest.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

anyOf.description: Weekly times shown on the card, such as service times or opening hours. Visitors see them on the page; search engines and AI assistants can read them.

entries.description: One entry per time, up to 20: a day with two services has two entries. [] removes the times.

day.description: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday.

end.description: Optional 24-hour "HH:MM" end. An end before the start runs past midnight.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the times are in, named for a place, like "America/Chicago" or "Europe/London" (or "UTC"). Not an abbreviation like "EST" or an offset. Ask the user if unsure.

title.description: Shown above the times, like "Service times", "Mass times" or "Hours". Defaults to "Service times".

times.description: Contact cards only: every weekly time, such as service times or opening hours, replacing the current ones. Days are 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday; times are 24-hour "HH:MM" in an IANA time zone. null or entries [] removes them.

url.description: A web address (https://…), a bare domain, or an email address.

urls.description: Rows of posts only: every post link, in order, replacing the current list.

website.description: Contact cards only: the website (null removes it).

name: update_block
title: Update a block
